189.synopsis:
A two year old ordinary cat travels through time to become a thousand year old demon cat, Hua Miao Miao.
Little Miao Miao doesn’t understand the complications of life, still acting like an ordinary cat.
Unexpectedly, Hua Miao Miao meets Bi Qing Shen Jun, a warrior god who looks like her previous owner, and is tricked by him to go to the heavens to become his disciple.
Under the tutelage of Shifu Bi Qing Shen Jun, after going through numerous painful challenges, little Miao Miao finally understands what it means to be a “cat.”
Can’t undress in front of other people, except Shifu.
Can’t elope with other men, except Shifu.
Can’t hug or kiss other people, except Shifu.
Can’t accept roses from Xiao Tian Quan, except given by Shifu.
Can’t go to Underwater Third Dragon Prince’s palace to eat fish, except cooked by Shifu.

Not allowed to go to a brothel to earn money? Not allowed to cause chaos or accept proposals?
Meow~ I don’t remember…… Shifu, don’t be angry.

Yasohachi is at a loss regarding what to do and goes to meet a man famed for his ability as an exorcist. The man’s skin is unnaturally pale and he covers his eyes with a red cloth.

Ji Bu, a gold-medal talent manager who was framed and sent to prison, wakes up one day reborn as Xin Nanyi—a debauched, vicious fù èr dài (rich second-generation heir). On her first day back, Jiang Momo was sternly warned by the family not to even think about trying to claim the fake daughter’s identity or inheritance.
Jiang Momo didn’t care at all. She nodded casually and on the very first day she gained residency on the Capital Star, she enrolled in the prestigious Central Mecha Academy, known for having the highest admission standards.
***
On enrollment day at the Central Mecha Academy, Jiang Momo luckily found a sparse registration lane among the overcrowded queues.
After submitting her form, she passed through all the exams with ease and was successfully selected as… a mecha manufacturing instructor.
Jiang Momo looked at her work badge. “…Wait, I came to learn how to pilot mechas, not teach people how to manufacture them!”
***
Rumor had it that a new instructor suddenly emerged at Central Mecha Academy, capable of creating legendary mechas. She even had a stash of long-extinct precious materials.
To help their beloved daughter shine at the upcoming semester-end Mecha Competition, the wealthy Jiang family pulled every string they could to get the instructor’s ID and address.
Then, at the heavily-paid-for address, they found Jiang Momo buried in familiar-looking junk, deeply engrossed in her research.
Without looking up at the unexpected visitors, Jiang Momo said, “A-grade mecha, two million. S-grade, ten million. Legendary, a hundred million.”
The wealthy man roared, “We’re your family!”
Jiang Momo: “The price’s double for family.”

113597.synopsis:
Ruined by a father who neglected his family for gambling, Marie’s household collapsed. Her mother passed away, and she barely managed to survive with her younger sibling thanks to her mother’s friend. But her deceased father left behind another debt, and to protect her family, Marie had no choice but to sell herself.
The man she meets takes control of her entire life and slowly unearths truths buried deep in her past.
Dominant Omega Marie Alphrose has a damaged pheromone gland and has to pretend to be a recessive Omega.
She tries to protect her sister and live with her aunt, who had become their guardian, but the kingdom is a cruel place to recessive Omegas.
Facing the prospect of being sold to pay for her long-dead father’s gambling debt, Marie’s only option is to become a courtesan.
The man who makes her an offer she can’t refuse is Russell, the kingdom’s only crown prince.

114621.synopsis:
I transmigrated as an extra in a hopeless dark fantasy novel.
…But the heroines are somehow strange.

121021.synopsis:
In the middle of the night, I saw a WeChat message on my boyfriend’s phone: “If you didn’t have a girlfriend, would you like me?”
He replied with one word: “Yes.”
I handed him the chat record to see.
After a long silence, he stubbed out his cigarette.
“I told you she’s just a colleague, and I’ve promised nothing will happen with her in the future, isn’t that enough?”
As he said this, there was no expression on his face, but the disappointment and blame in his voice were unmistakable.
At that moment, I realized I might not know this person at all.
associated_names: 沒有女生能笑著從男友手機裡走出來

122557.synopsis:
Kang He transmigrated into the body of a simple-minded young man who had become a live-in son-in-law.
The family he married into was dirt poor.
Not a grain of rice was left after the new year, not a single copper coin in the chest.
Just three thatched rooms and barely-sufficient farmland.
The father-in-law was honest and mild-tempered; the mother-in-law, sharp-tongued but quick-witted.
As for the husband—he never spoke a word, only worked hard to earn money and support the family.
Fortunately, he was originally a fool.

125885.synopsis:
Top 1% ultra-dominant Alpha, captain of University A’s ice hockey team, born with wealth. Cheon Je-gyeom’s life had not even a speck of deficiency. …Except for Baek Narin.
Mom’s friend’s daughter, childhood friend, next-door leech, stalker, sasaeng fan……
The titles changed dozens of times, but the fact that Je-gyeom disliked Narin always stayed the same.
If Cheon Je-gyeom had one and only wish, it was that Baek Narin would just stay away from him.
“I’m really sick and tired of it, so don’t ever show up in front of me again!”
“Okay. I’ll stop liking you from now on.”
How could someone’s love change this easily?
How could love… change?
Instead of a love confession, he’s hit with a love renunciation, and the relationship he thought would forever stay in his control flips upside down.
From that day on, Cheon Je-gyeom’s Stalker Observation Log began.
Cheon Je-gyeom’s brows furrowed miserably as he saw Baek Narin cheerfully humming her way toward the main gate of campus. He had no way of hiding his physical superiority, which far surpassed the average, so he pathetically stuck to the wall, trying to conceal his body.
After making me like this……
He whipped off his mask and cap and grabbed his tousled hair. The pain caused by the erection swelling inside the c**k cage brought tears to his eyes behind the black sunglasses.
Do you really not like me?
How can you not like me?
This face, this body—was it really that easy to give up on?

128445.synopsis:
Leo found himself transported into a desolate wasteland, the remnants of a once-thriving magical civilization. There, he became Yvette – an immortal witch who could neither age nor die.
For over a thousand years, Yvette lived in seclusion, hiding from the dangers of the ruined world, But now, at long last, she has decided to step out of the shadows.
Only then does she realize a something unexpected: She may be the last surviving soul of that lost civilization.

130237.synopsis:
“If you’re that kind, I’ll fall in love with you, Sensei.”
Ichigohara Itsuki. Late twenties. Married. High school teacher. And yet, I made a move on a female student who was 10 years younger than me.
The student’s name is Togawa Rin. She’s taller than me, gentle, somewhat youthful, and pretty. And she’s a really nice girl. While I was concerned about her because of her troubled home environment, we ended up kissing in bed.
It was undoubtedly betrayal, infidelity, adultery, and a crime. How could I have gathered all these elements that could bring about my own ruin?
How did it end up like this?
Le*d and unfaithful, yet somehow warm. A love story between a female teacher and a female student.

132797.synopsis:
Shen Xici, after being reborn, finds that he is always picking people up.
On the roadside, he picked up a director who was drunk and lying on the ground looking at the moon. Shen Xici, a minor supporting actor: “Stop lying around, get up and work 007-style on editing the film!”
Director: “You’re rebelling against heaven!”
A few months later, the box office broke two billion. The director, holding a new script: “I’m begging you, please rebel against heaven just one more time!”
While on a walk, he picked up a two-time Golden Award-winning actress who had fainted from low blood sugar. Shen Xici, a newcomer actor: “Stop dieting. Your problem isn’t your figure, it’s your taste in choosing roles.”
Actress: “Are you telling me what to do??”
At the awards ceremony, the now three-time Golden Award-winning actress, holding her trophy: “Please put the camera on my life mentor, Shen Xici!”
He picked up a man with amnesia who was injured. Shen Xici let him sleep on the sofa in his house. After regaining his memory, the man left, leaving behind a check.
Unexpectedly, a few days later, Shen Xici pushed open the door of a hotel room and found a person had grown on the sofa.
When he returned to his rental apartment, a person had grown on the sofa again.
After moving, Shen Xici deliberately did not buy a sofa.
At three in the morning, Sheng Shaoyan, bringing his own sofa, knocked on his new door.
Shen Xici: “…”
A cat staging an accident?
__
After Sheng Shaoyan lost his memory, he felt that his live-in boyfriend, Shen Xici, was perfect except for being too poor. Not only did he perfectly match his aesthetic tastes, but he also knew all his preferences and habits, and was exceptionally considerate.
Sheng Shaoyan was very satisfied.
Until his memory returned—
What, he doesn’t have a boyfriend at all?
Shen Xici is just… a passing stranger?
Sheng Shaoyan: I don’t believe it.
People who appeared by his side always had ulterior motives.
Is Shen Xici trying to bait him?
That’s not out of the question.
Sheng Shaoyan waited and waited.
One day, two days,
Three months, four months…
Sheng Shaoyan got anxious. Why isn’t Shen Xici baiting him yet?
__
Xu Lingjia had a prophetic dream.
His parents were the Best Actor and Best Actress. As the most-watched second-generation star in the entertainment industry, he was actually a fake young master.
In the dream, although he had defeated the real young master, Shen Xici, after Shen Xici’s death, the final scene of the dream was of a man whose face he couldn’t see, stomping his face into the ground until it was a bloody pulp, and asking slowly, “That day, was it you who stabbed his hand with a knife?”
On the day he woke from the dream, looking at Shen Xici, who was a minor supporting actor on the set, just drenched by heavy rain, Xu Lingjia suddenly clenched the script tightly.
He touched his own faintly aching face, his fingertips turning cold.
It’s okay; there’s still time for everything.

168381.synopsis:
To make her husband emperor, she became his older brother’s mistress and began guiding him.
But all she got in return was devastating betrayal and a miserable death.
‘I will never forgive them.’
If only for the sake of the child in her womb, who died without ever seeing the light.
Just as she swore she would never forgive the husband and sister who betrayed her, she miraculously went back in time and regressed to the past.
Eight years earlier, to before she first met her husband.
“I’ll make you emperor, Your Highness. I’m the only one who can guide you.”
To Kyren, the First Prince, who was living like a man with a death sentence while driven by revenge, she proposed a contract marriage.
There was only one condition.
Once her revenge was over, and once he became emperor, they would divorce.
But then.
“Never.”
A possessive hunger glinted dangerously in Kyren’s crimson eyes.
“I am never letting you go, Anesa.”
associated_names: At My Husband’s Command, I Became a Mistress
